heading_en: Application for Approval of the Special Exclusion from Calculation of the BI
summary_ja: BIの算出に係る除外特例の承認申請書の記載事項及び添付書類を定める。
summary_en: Sets out the contents of the application for approval of the special exclusion from the BI calculation and the documents to be attached.
paragraphs: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company seeking the approval under the preceding Article shall submit to the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency a written application for approval stating the following matters. (i) The matters set out in Article 287, paragraph (1), items (i) and (ii). (ii) The name and outline of the consolidated subsidiary corporation, etc. or business unit for which it seeks the special exclusion from the calculation of the BI under the provisions of the preceding Article. (iii) The date on which the special exclusion under the preceding item is to begin to apply. (iv) The amounts of the BI in the case where the special exclusion under item (ii) is applied and in the case where it is not applied. (v) The trial calculation values of the operational risk equivalent amount and the consolidated capital adequacy ratio in the case where the special exclusion under item (ii) is applied and in the case where it is not applied.

The following documents shall be attached to the written application for approval in the preceding paragraph. (i) A written statement of reasons. (ii) A document showing that the consolidated subsidiary corporation, etc. or business unit in item (ii) of the preceding paragraph has been disposed of. (iii) A document showing that it does not currently conduct, and does not plan to conduct in the future, business similar to that of the consolidated subsidiary corporation, etc. or business unit in item (ii) of the preceding paragraph. (iv) A document stating any other matters that would serve as a reference.
